title: SparkFi
tagline: A Decentralized Crowdfunding platform to kickstart new ideas
description: Fixes some issue of traditional crowdfunding platforms such as Kickstarter through the use of Smart Contracts. Venture manager will have to make a "proposal" before spending any of the donated money by specifying the amount of money to be used and where it will be sent to. Investors then vote on whether or not the proposal should pass.
how_its_made: Before this hackathon, I was not confident in smart contract programming. But this hackathon pushed me to study fast and although I needed more time, I have learned a lot and I am grateful to have joined. I also found Moralis' boilerplate template to be very useful in creating a beautiful front end and quickly connecting it to the smart contract back end.
